# Third-party code

`xlsx.full.min.js` is SheetJS community edition **0.18.5**, copied unmodified from
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js

- Project: https://sheetjs.com ("xlsx.js (C) 2013-present SheetJS")
- Licence: Apache License 2.0 — https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

It is kept in this folder so Excel export works without an internet connection. Do not edit it; to upgrade, replace the file with another pinned release.
